title: On a Mindless website the timer runs: a drill plays in place and the timer section keeps time to the bell

source.ref: Owner ask 2026-11-18: build the timer using the design system

detail:
Found on the Mindless Home: the design system's SessionPlayer was drawn as a picture of a timer. Under "Try one now. Sixty seconds." each drill's play button was a link to the Services page, the bar sat at 0:00 and nothing kept time. A visitor who pressed play left the page.

DONE 2026-11-18: the SessionPlayer runs (components/sites/mindless-timer.tsx): play, pause, a bar that fills, a breath pacer on the guide line (in for five, out for five) and a soft double bell at the end. Nothing is saved or sent. A drill with no link plays in place; a drill an owner has linked stays a door, so stored sites do not change. The seeded drills carry no link. A new section, Mindless timer, pairs the design's ChoiceGroup (the lengths) with the player and a drip clock; an owner sets the lengths and can turn the pacer off. The few extra rules live in lib/theme/mindless-timer-css.ts, scoped to a Mindless site (ADR-1906) and drawn only from the design's tokens. Rendered inside the Mindless site chrome at 390, 1280, 1440, 1920 and 2000, ready and running, with no sideways scroll.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
